# Fedfina Brand Profile

Extracted from investor presentations Q3 FY25 and Q3 FY26 on 2026-04-26.

## Identity

- Display name: Fedbank Financial Services Limited
- Short brand name: Fedfina
- Industry: Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC), retail lending. Core products: gold loans, mortgages (LAP, including small-ticket micro-LAP), business loans.
- Tagline: EMPOWERING EMERGING INDIA WITH EASY ACCESS TO LOANS
- Listing: NSE symbol FEDFINA, BSE scrip code 544027
- CIN: L65910MH1995PLC364635 (incorporated 1995)
- Registered office: Unit No. 1101, 11th Floor, Cignus, Plot No 71 A, Paspoli, Powai, Mumbai 400087
- Tone of voice: Formal, conservative, regulator-aware, numbers-first. Heavy reliance on quantified outcomes (YoY, QoQ, bps, INR Cr). Forward-looking statements always carry caveats. Sentence structure is declarative and measured, never aspirational fluff. The deck never uses first-person plural casually, it uses "the Company" in legal sections and "we" only inside operational headers like "Who we are" and "Our Business".
- Target audience: Primary audience is institutional investors and equity analysts (the deck is filed with NSE and BSE quarterly). Secondary audience is regulators (RBI compliance signals, asset quality framing). Tertiary audience is rating agencies and lenders. Customer-facing language is absent in this format, customers are referenced statistically not narratively.

## Visual

- Primary color: deep corporate navy blue, hex approximately #0A3A8A. Used for headings, section labels, all chart bars, the brand mark.
- Secondary color: warm gold / amber, hex approximately #F5A623. Used for accent shapes in the brand mark, page footer underline, callout chip backgrounds for QoQ deltas, accent text on dark headers.
- Tertiary: pure white background. Light hex pattern watermark in the top-right corner of every slide (faint cube/hexagon outlines) gives subtle texture without competing with content.
- Heading font: Inter (confirmed by V on 2026-04-26). Wordmark FEDBANK in the logo asset is a custom bold italic-leaning geometric sans, kept verbatim and not replaced by Inter.
- Body font: Inter (confirmed by V on 2026-04-26). Bullet glyph is a navy filled triangle right-pointer, not a standard round bullet.
- Logo: navy rectangular block containing the wordmark "FEDBANK" stacked above a thinner line "FINANCIAL SERVICES LIMITED" in white. Brand mark beside or separate from the wordmark is a stylized cross or "X" formed by two interlocking diamond/lozenge shapes, one navy and one gold, with curved navy stroke accents extending outward. The mark reads as motion plus structure, the implied message is "interlocking strength".
- Slide layout: navy section-header ribbon top-left with rounded right end, gold underline along the bottom of every slide, brand block locked to top-right corner.

## Key facts

Latest (Q3 FY26, quarter ended December 2025):
- AUM: Rs 17,500 Cr, up 17.4% YoY, up 8.5% QoQ
- Disbursements in quarter: Rs 8,606 Cr, up 95.8% YoY
- Gold Loan AUM: Rs 7,905 Cr, 51.9% YoY growth, 45.2% of total AUM
- Mortgage AUM: Rs 9,084 Cr, 20.0% YoY growth
- Secured AUM: 98.4% of book
- Branches: 730 (37 added YoY, 31 QoQ)
- Employees: 5,085 plus 372 apprentices
- Net Interest Income: Rs 318.9 Cr, up 16.8% YoY
- Profit After Tax: Rs 87.9 Cr, up 368.6% YoY
- GNPA: 2.1%, NNPA: 1.4%, Credit Cost: 0.9%
- RoA: 2.5%, RoE: 12.7%
- Capital Adequacy Ratio (CRAR): 20.5%
- Borrowings: Rs 11,207 Cr
- Shareholder funds: Rs 2,806 Cr, Book Value per share: Rs 75.0

Prior year reference (Q3 FY25, quarter ended December 2024):
- AUM: Rs 14,922 Cr (39.3% YoY at the time)
- Q3 FY25 PAT was Rs 18.8 Cr, depressed by a one-time Rs 75 Cr provision (Rs 57 Cr on mortgage and discontinued construction finance NPAs, Rs 18 Cr management overlay), making the FY26 PAT comparison optically large.

Operating regions: pan-India, with focus on Tier 2 and Tier 3 towns (NBFC retail lending model). Specific state mix not extracted from the first five pages.

## Notes for Lucy

- Always present numbers with units (Rs Cr, %, bps), never bare integers
- Always pair growth metrics with both YoY and QoQ where the source has both
- Mirror the deck cadence: Business, Branches, Profitability, Asset Quality and Provisioning
- Default registry is Indian English business formal, not American business casual
- Never use first-person aspirational language ("we believe", "we dream"), Fedfina copy stays grounded in measured outcomes
- Never use em-dashes or en-dashes in copy generated for Fedfina, the source decks use periods and commas
- Treat asset quality and provisioning conservatively, surface caveats rather than hide them, this matches the deck's regulator-aware posture
